page.overview:
Who is Kresh?

The Kresh are the archenemies of Tech Jacket and enemies of the Geldarians as unseen characters in Invincible.

Not much is known about the Kresh, other than that they were once hired by the Viltrum Empire to exterminate the Geldarians, a plan which ultimately failed due to “immense sacrifice and loss.”
